requirements.description: Single-hand house-edged Deuces Wild applies wild-deuce hand ranking and the documented returned-credit paytable, with the four-of-a-kind return reduced so optimal play is no longer player-positive.
requirements.notes: Issue #77 allocation covers the canonical wild-deuce precedence and payout profile. The full-pay schedule was player-positive under optimal hold (~100.42%); reducing four_of_a_kind from 5 to 4 (the canonical deuces house-edge lever) lands optimal-play RTP at ~94.05% with the hand-ranking order intact (issue #456).

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe active hands, holds, history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Bound session identity overrides caller player ids.

requirements.description: Wagers and returned credits use the shared ledger exactly once under stable deal and draw identities.
requirements.notes: No balance mutation occurs outside the ledger.

requirements.description: Deuces Wild supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe play across required viewports.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales and every governed viewport.
